title.narrative: Provision of Winter NFIs for IDP, returnees and host community In Al-Hasakeh Governorate

description.narrative: ltpgtThe project will be implemented in Al-Hasakah Governorate, in the Markada and Tal Tamr areas.ltbrgtThe project aims to provide support to families in need with Winter NFIs for the most vulnerable groups, to mitigate the effects of the harsh winter cold. The project falls within envelopes ltbgt(1 and 2) of First Standard Allocation 2025lt/bgt, as we will work on:ltbrgt1- Humanitarian Support to Displaced Populations and Vulnerable Host Communities: This envelope will account for approximately ltbgt90%lt/bgt of the total beneficiaries, with the targeted number of host communities and displaced persons (3,000 families = 15,000 people).ltbrgt2- Supporting Safe and Dignified Return from Areas of Displacement to Areas of Origin: This envelope will account for approximately ltbgt10%lt/bgt of the total beneficiaries. The targeted number of returnees is (300 families = 1,500 individuals).ltbrgtWe will provide beneficiaries with basic materials to help them enhance their personal warmth, given the region's extreme cold and extreme poverty. We will distribute diesel stoves and carpets according to the specifications and guidelines of the NFI sector catalog.ltbrgtThus, the project is of great importance in contributing to achieving the goal of the non-food items sector, as it contributes to enhancing personal warmth and protection from weather factors and the harsh winter cold.ltbrgt3,300 families, representing approximately 16,500 individuals, will be targeted.ltbrgtEach targeted family will receive (one diesel stove and one carpet) Provide a sum of money to purchase 300 liters of diesel (local authorities in Hasakah Governorate are distributing 300 liters of diesel to each household at a subsidized price of 1,000 SYP).ltbrgtEach household head will receive $29.50, which includes the value of the subsidized diesel distributed by the local authorities, transfer fees, and transportation costs to receive the transfer.ltbrgtTargeting criteria are:ltbrgt- Female-headed householdsltbrgt- Households with disabilitiesltbrgt- The poorest households.ltbrgt- Displaced Personsltbrgt- ReturneesltbrgtThe project includes one sector (NFI) because there is a great need for non-food items and there is a large number of eligible families. Therefore, the project cost is high for this sector, especially since there is a specific ceiling for our organization in funding. Also, through communication with other organizations, they mentioned that they will target the region with projects within different sectors.ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtCoordination was conducted with the Relief Sub-Committee in Al-Hasakah Governorate and the Directorate of Social Affairs and Labor. The targeted communities were also consulted to determine intervention priorities. All local authorities on the ground within the targeted area were contacted and the necessary approvals were obtained for the project.ltbrgtSham AlKhair will implement the project in accordance with quality and quality control requirements for the entire distribution service and for non-food specifications to meet the required needs. The project will apply mainstreaming protection through the principles of do no harm and non-discrimination in project design, implementation, and monitoring. Priority will be given to the safety and security of the distribution site, as well as meaningful access to people with disabilities, with the possibility of the distribution team reaching out to people who are unable to reach the distribution site.lt/pgt
